comments.message: FOUR! Jiten Ramanandi to Josh Inglis. Length ball, down leg side on the front foot driving, well timed in the air under control past long on for 4 runs. Australia make light work of the run chase, racing to the target inside 10 overs as they finish a disappointing World Cup campaign on a winning note. With only 105 required for victory, openers Mitchell Marsh and Travis Head wasted no time, putting on 73 in the powerplay. Shakeel Ahmed removed Head with the only wicket, but Josh Inglis joined Marsh in crossing the line, Marsh passing a half century in the process to finish unbeaten on 64 off just 33 balls. Adam Zampa has been named the Player of the Match.
